blocks.text: Ab hum pehli qisam ki equation dekhte hain jo sab se aasaani se solve hoti hai. Naam hi sab kuch bata deta hai: separable, yani jis ke variables ko alag alag kiya ja sake. Agar aap \(x\) wali saari cheezein ek taraf aur \(y\) wali saari cheezein doosri taraf kar sakein, to bas dono taraf integrate kijiye aur kaam khatam.
Kitab ki definition: first order, first degree differential equation ko Separable kehte hain agar usay is tarah likha ja sake:

\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = g(x)\,h(y)\]
ya
\[g(x)\,dx = \dfrac{1}{h(y)}\,dy\]
Yani right side ek aise function \(g(x)\) jis mein sirf \(x\) ho, aur ek aise function \(h(y)\) jis mein sirf \(y\) ho, ka product (zarb) ho.
Misaal ke tor par \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{x}{y}\) separable hai, kyunke usay \(y\,dy = -x\,dx\) likh sakte hain. Lekin \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + y}{y - x}\) separable nahi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Pehchanein kaise? Equation ko \(\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)\) likhiye aur koshish kijiye ke \(f\) ko (sirf \(x\)) \(\times\) (sirf \(y\)) mein tor sakein.
\(-\frac{x}{y} = (-x) \cdot \frac{1}{y}\): toot gaya, to separable.
\(\frac{x + y}{y - x}\): yahan \(x + y\) aur \(y - x\) mein dono letters jama ya minus ki shakal mein jure hue hain. Jama ko zarb mein nahi tora ja sakta, is liye yeh separable nahi. Fikr na karein, isay hum 4.2.2 mein doosre tareeqe se hal karenge.
Ek misaal: separable equation aisi hai jaise daal aur chawal alag alag bartanon mein hon, aap har ek ko alag se utha sakte hain. Lekin \(x + y\) aisa hai jaise dono pehle se mila kar pakaye gaye hon; ab alag nahi hote.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Kya \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x + y}\) separable hai? Aur \(\frac{dy}{dx} = x + y\)?
(Jawab: pehli haan, kyunke \(e^{x + y} = e^x \cdot e^y\), zarb ban gaya. Doosri nahi, kyunke \(x + y\) ko kisi zarb mein nahi tor sakte.)
Method to Solve a Separable Differential Equation

Kitab tareeqa yun samjhati hai. Separable equation
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = g(x)\,h(y)\]
ko dono taraf \(h(y)\) se divide aur \(dx\) se multiply kar ke yun likh sakte hain:
\[\dfrac{1}{h(y)}\,dy = g(x)\,dx\]

Ab dono taraf integrate kijiye:
\[\int \dfrac{1}{h(y)}\,dy = \int g(x)\,dx\]
Dono taraf ke integrals hal karne se separable differential equation ka general solution mil jata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Tareeqa teen qadmon mein yaad kar lijiye:
1. Alag karein: \(y\) wala hissa \(dy\) ke saath, \(x\) wala hissa \(dx\) ke saath.
2. Dono taraf integrate karein, har side apne variable ke hisaab se.
3. Sirf ek taraf ek arbitrary constant lagayein aur jawab ko saaf karein.
Ek hi constant kyun? Left side ka integral \(+c_1\) deta hai aur right side ka \(+c_2\). Dono ko ek taraf le jayein to \(c_2 - c_1\) bhi bas ek constant hai, is liye seedha ek \(c\) likh dete hain.
Kab use karein? Jab bhi \(f(x, y)\) ko \(g(x)h(y)\) mein tora ja sake. Hamesha sab se pehle yahi tareeqa try karein, kyunke yeh sab se chhota hai.
Chhoti si ehtiyaat: \(h(y)\) se divide karte waqt hum maan rahe hain ke \(h(y) \ne 0\). Agar kisi value \(y = k\) par \(h(k) = 0\) ho, to wahan \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\) hai aur constant function \(y = k\) bhi ek solution hai.

blocks.title: Numbering note (ours)
blocks.text: Kitab yahan examples ki numbering dobara shuru kar deti hai: woh "Example 2" aur "Example 3" chhaapti hai, halaanke Examples 1 se 4 pehle hi 4.1.1 mein aa chuke hain (doosra Example 1 kahin nahi hai). Taake is unit ki har example ka apna alag number ho, hum kitab ki doosri Example 2 ko Example 5 aur doosri Example 3 ko Example 6 dikhate hain. Kitab mein dhoondte waqt yeh farq yaad rakhiye.

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.problem: Find the general solution of the differential equation \(x\,dx + y\,dy = 0\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x\,dx + y\,dy = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Dekhiye, \(x\) wali term pehle se \(dx\) ke saath hai aur \(y\) wali term \(dy\) ke saath. Yani variables pehle hi alag alag hain, equation separable hai. Hum \(y\,dy\) ko left par rakhenge, \(x\,dx\) ko right par bhejenge aur dono taraf integrate karenge.

Qadam 1: Variables alag karein
\[y\,dy = -x\,dx\]
Kyun: \(x\,dx\) ko equal ke nishan ke paar le gaye to us ka sign badal gaya. Ab left side par sirf \(y\) hai aur right side par sirf \(x\); bilkul aise jaise do bachon ko alag alag kamron mein bitha diya ho.

Qadam 2: Dono taraf integrate karein
\[\int y\,dy = -\int x\,dx\]
\[\dfrac{y^2}{2} = -\dfrac{x^2}{2} + c\]
Kyun: Power rule \(\int u\,du = \frac{u^2}{2}\) lagaya. Left side ka integral \(y\) ke hisaab se aur right side ka \(x\) ke hisaab se hua. Dono taraf alag alag constant likhne ki zaroorat nahi; dono mil kar ek hi constant \(c\) ban jate hain.

Qadam 3: Fractions khatam karein
\[y^2 = -x^2 + 2c\]
Kyun: Har term ko 2 se multiply kiya taake neeche wala 2 chala jaye.

Qadam 4: Constant ka naam dobara rakhein
\(c\) koi bhi constant ho sakta hai, is liye kitab \(c\) ki jagah \(\frac{c}{2}\) rakh deti hai; is se \(2c\) sirf \(c\) ban jata hai:
\[x^2 + y^2 = c\]
Kyun: Arbitrary constant ka do guna bhi arbitrary constant hi hai, to us ko phir se \(c\) keh sakte hain. Jawab saaf suthra ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Yeh "constant badalna" ghalti nahi, bilkul jaiz qadam hai. Bas \(x\) ya \(y\) ko kabhi constant mein shamil na karein.

Tasdeeq:
\(x^2 + y^2 = c\) ko \(x\) ke hisaab se differentiate karein:
\[2x + 2y\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 0\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{x}{y}\]
Yeh wapas \(x\,dx + y\,dy = 0\) hi hai, is liye jawab sahi hai. Graph ki zabaan mein: \(c > 0\) ke liye yeh origin par centre wale circles hain.
blocks.answer: \(x^2 + y^2 = c\), jahan \(c\) arbitrary constant hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Example 5 mein jawab \(y^2 = -x^2 + 2c\) bhi chhora ja sakta tha; yeh bhi wahi curves ka khandaan hai. Constant ka naam badalna (\(2c\) ko \(c\), \(\ln|c|\), \(e^c\) waghera) jaiz hai, kyunke constant arbitrary hai. Exam mein aksar do sahi jawab sirf constant ki shakal mein mukhtalif hote hain, is liye ghabrayein nahi; differentiate kar ke check kar lein.

blocks.title: Example 6
blocks.problem: Find the general solution for the differential equation \(x^2(2y + 1)\frac{dy}{dx} - 1 = 0\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^2(2y + 1)\frac{dy}{dx} - 1 = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Pehle \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela kar lein. Right side \(\frac{1}{x^2} \cdot \frac{1}{2y + 1}\) banegi, yani (sirf \(x\) ka function) zarb (sirf \(y\) ka function). Yahi separable ki pehchaan hai, to variables alag kar ke integrate karenge.

Qadam 1: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko akela likhein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{1}{x^2(2y + 1)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 1 jama kiya, phir \(x^2(2y + 1)\) se divide kiya. Ab equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)\) wali shakal mein hai aur hum \(f\) ko ghaur se dekh sakte hain.

Qadam 2: Variables alag karein
\[(2y + 1)\,dy = \dfrac{1}{x^2}\,dx\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((2y + 1)\,dx\) se multiply kiya. Ab \(y\) wali har cheez \(dy\) ke saath hai aur \(x\) wali har cheez \(dx\) ke saath.
Dhyan dein: \(x^2\) ko left par mat chhoriye; agar ek taraf dono variables reh gaye to integrate nahi kar sakenge.

Qadam 3: Dono taraf integrate karein
\[\int (2y + 1)\,dy = \int \dfrac{1}{x^2}\,dx\]
\[2\int y\,dy + \int dy = \int x^{-2}\,dx\]
Kyun: Left wale integral ko term by term toda. Right side par \(\frac{1}{x^2}\) ko \(x^{-2}\) likha taake power rule seedha lag sake.

Qadam 4: Integrals hal karein
\[y^2 + y = -\dfrac{1}{x} + C\]
Kyun: \(2 \cdot \frac{y^2}{2} = y^2\) aur \(\int dy = y\). Right side par \(\int x^{-2}\,dx = \frac{x^{-1}}{-1} = -\frac{1}{x}\), kyunke power rule mein power ek barhti hai (\(-2 + 1 = -1\)) aur nayi power se divide hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\int x^{-2}\,dx\) ka jawab \(\frac{1}{x}\) likh dena (minus bhool jana) bahut aam ghalti hai.

Qadam 5: Jawab ko saaf karein
\[y^2 + y + \dfrac{1}{x} = C\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{1}{x}\) ko left par le gaye to woh \(+\frac{1}{x}\) ban gaya. Kitab bhi jawab isi shakal mein deti hai.

Tasdeeq:
Jawab ko \(x\) ke hisaab se differentiate karein (\(y\) ko \(x\) ka function samajh kar):
\[(2y + 1)\dfrac{dy}{dx} - \dfrac{1}{x^2} = 0\]
\(x^2\) se multiply karein:
\[x^2(2y + 1)\dfrac{dy}{dx} - 1 = 0\]
Yeh bilkul di hui equation hai, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.answer: \(y^2 + y + \frac{1}{x} = C\), jahan \(C\) arbitrary constant hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal hamari apni hai. \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x}{y^2}\) solve kijiye.
Alag karein: \(y^2\,dy = x\,dx\). Integrate: \(\frac{y^3}{3} = \frac{x^2}{2} + c\). 6 se multiply: \(2y^3 = 3x^2 + C\).
Check: differentiate karein to \(6y^2\frac{dy}{dx} = 6x\), yani \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x}{y^2}\). Bilkul sahi.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Exam mein separable sawal par pehli line hamesha yeh likhiye: "The given equation is separable" aur phir alag ki hui shakal. Is se examiner ko foran pata chal jata hai ke aap ne qisam pehchan li hai. Aakhir mein ek line ka check (differentiate kar ke) ghaltiyan pakar leta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Separable ka matlab: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = g(x)\,h(y)\), yani right side sirf-\(x\) aur sirf-\(y\) functions ka zarb hai.
2. Tareeqa: alag karein, dono taraf integrate karein, ek constant lagayein.
3. Constant ka naam badal sakte hain (\(2c\) ko \(c\), \(\ln|c|\), ...) taake jawab saaf ho.
4. Jawab ko differentiate kar ke check karein: asal equation wapas milni chahiye.
5. Agar \(f(x, y)\) mein \(x + y\) jaisa jama ho jo zarb mein na toote, to equation separable nahi; homogeneous wala tareeqa (4.2.2) try karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Aisi side ko integrate kar dena jis mein abhi \(x\) aur \(y\) dono hon, jaise \(\int x^2(2y + 1)\,dy\) mein \(x\) ko constant samajh lena. Pehle poori tarah alag karein.
2. Dono taraf \(+c\) likhna, ya bilkul bhool jana.
3. Yeh samajhna ke \(e^{x + y}\) separable nahi: yeh hai, kyunke \(e^{x + y} = e^x e^y\). Lekin sirf \(x + y\) (exponential ke baghair) separable nahi.
4. Term ko doosri taraf le jaate waqt sign bhool jana: \(x\,dx + y\,dy = 0\) se \(y\,dy = -x\,dx\) banta hai, \(+x\,dx\) nahi.
